full_judgment: In the case before us there is nothing to show that trial Court had been misled by fraud or that there has been actual and positive fraud relating to the proceeding of the Court or a premeditated or intentional contrivance to keep the parties and the court in ignorance of the real and material facts in order to obtain decree by that contrivance. Nothing of the kind appears to have been found by the appellate Court. There is simply finding on presumption that the decree was obtained by bribery and corruption without evidence.
